get up.en: On Sunday, I get up a little later.
get up.cn: 周日我起得稍微晚一点。

morning.en: In the morning, the sun is bright and warm.

breakfast.en: A good breakfast gives us energy for the day.
breakfast.cn: 好的早餐让我们一天都有精神。

wash.en: I wash my face in the morning.
Please wash the apples before you eat them.
wash.cn: 吃苹果前请先把它们洗干净。

face.en: She has a big smile on her face.
face.cn: 她脸上挂着大大的笑容。

brush.en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
Don't forget to brush your teeth before bed.

tooth.en: Brush your teeth carefully every morning and night.

ready.en: When breakfast is ready, Mum calls us to the table.
ready.cn: 早餐准备好时，妈妈叫我们到桌前。
